games.name: NEW [BETA] Mount Setapak
games.desc:
🌿 Mount Setapak – A Realistic Hiking Simulation
Mount Setapak is a solo hiking simulation set in a peaceful forest environment, designed to give players an immersive and realistic mountain trail experience.
Follow a winding forest trail, cross wooden bridges, pass waterfalls, and reach a basecamp before continuing toward the summit.

🗺️ Gameplay Features:
🌲 Realistic forest trail navigation
💧 Natural terrain with ponds and waterfalls
🏕️ Basecamp system before summit progression
🚶 Slow-paced, immersive hiking mechanics
🏔️ Summit tracking system - reach 100 summits to unlock the hidden Trail 100 challenge

⚠️ Notes:
😌 No enemies or combat - purely exploration and hiking-focused
🎧 Recommended to play with sound on for full immersion

Mount Setapak — a realistic hiking journey, one step at a time.

games.name: One Thousand Rooms
games.desc:
⚠️ Game contains extremely loud noises, blood, and violence

The objective is in the title, go through one thousand rooms in one piece. Numerous entities with different behaviors are out for your blood.
If you aren't careful, you could be a threat to your own self.
Good luck, you will really, really need it if you want to come out alive.


❗THERE ARE NO CHECKPOINTS! AND THERE WILL NEVER BE! RESPECT THAT! This game is meant to be a more time-taking, challenging rooms game than other games. If you die, then it's okay, always make sure you have the time put aside if you want to beat the game. In the end, beating the game will be a reward and less of a chore if you don't force yourself to beat it. Have fun!

Main inspirations:
Elevation
Rooms but Doors
